tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byin rlabs dbab pa dngul gyi gdung ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// yon tan nus mthu 'phrin las thogs med cing / /byin rlabs ye shes chu rgyun dpag med pas/ /'gro rnams nyams rtogs mchog la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mtshungs med chos rje rin chen zhabs la 'dud/ /de la bla ma'i byin rlabs gsol 'debs ma 'di/ mdun du rang bas khru gang bas mtho sar/ padma dang nyi zla'i steng du bla ma 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can zhig bsgom mo/ /de nas bla ma'i yon tan dran par bya ste snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba thun mong ma yin pa rang gzhan gnyis kas drag tu gdab par bya'o/ /de'i ngang las bla ma de las bla ma mang po mched nas/ slob ma'i spyi gtsug tu chem chem 'ur 'ur byon pa dang / byin gyis rlobs snyam du bsgom pa la/ yang gsol ba drag po gdab bo/ /des nad gdon dang sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye'o/ /dgyes rdor gyi byin rlabs ni dbang dang 'brel bar byas na/ thod pa'i nang du dgyes rdor sku gsung thugs dkar dmar mthing gsum bsam/ de nas nam mkha' la sangs rgyas la sogs pa dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa la/ rjes su yid rang bsgoms pas de'i bzang lan du 'od zer kha dog gsum thod pa'i lha la thim pas/ dgyes rdor bde stong gnyis su med pa'i sku gsum po de las 'od zer byung nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsgom/ de ni 'od zer ma'o/ /nus mthu ma ni/ lha gsum po de las nus mthu dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma la thim pas sdig sgrib dag par bsam mo/ /sku gzugs ma ni dus gsum gyi dge ba rnams yar la phul bas/ bzang lan du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad char pa bzhin du byung nas slob ma'i lus la sib sib thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon dang sdig sgrib thams cad sangs dag par bsgom mo/

/de yang dbang dang ma 'brel bar byas na/ nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'am sngags phyi nang gi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams bzhugs par bsam mo/ /rjes su yid rang bsgoms pas bzang lan du/ de rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung nas/ slob ma'i thugs la thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa sangs kyis dag par bsgom/ de ni nang 'od zer ma'o/ /nus mthu dang sku gzugs ma sngar bzhin bya'o/ /rang bde mchog tu bsgoms pa'i sku stod dang sku smad nas/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas slob ma la thim pa dang / nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par bsam mo/ /rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i ba spu'i bu ga nas khro mo dpag tu med pa byung / de las kyang khyad par du rje btsun ma byung nas lus la thim par bsams nas phaṭa ta phaṭa ta byas la rol mo drag tu bya/ yang na thod pa'i nang du sngags gsum sbrel 'od du zhu ba'i chang de slob ma la gtor bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs dag par bsgom/ de ni mkha' 'gro char 'bebs ma'o/ /rang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug par bsgoms pa'i thugs kha nas/ hūm̐ chen po gcig las hūm̐ mang po mched nas phyir thon pa dang / hūm̐ de rnams mgon por gyur te/ slob ma'i rgyud la sib sib thim pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs dag par bsgoms nas/ rtsa sngags drag tu bzlas/ rol mo rnams drag tu dkrol bar bya'o/ /char 'bebs ma'i gnad des ni/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dgos 'dod thams cad sgrub cing bran bzhin ci sgo ba rnams nyan par byed do/ /'di rnams nub gcig la byas na gsang sngags thang mar brdal bar 'gro bas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung bas zla ba re la lan re tsam nub sbrel mar bya'o/ /byin rlabs 'od zer ma dang / nus mthu ma dang /

sku gzugs ma gsum po 'di dges rdor/ bde mchog rje btsun ma/ mgon po la sogs pa rnams la thung mong ma yin pa'i gnad 'dis byin rlabs byas na rang dang slob ma'i nad gdon sdig sgrib la sogs pa rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad skad cig ma res zhi nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos su 'du zhing tshe gcig lus gcig gam/ skad cig ma res 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i byin rlabs 'di/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yid dam gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad kyi dngos su gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdams pa yin pas snod ldan re las mi byin no/ /khyad par du dpe la zab cing ster dus 'bul ba chen po dang / tshogs 'khor mang po ma byas par mi sbyin zhing / bka' yang yang gdams par bya'o/ /bde skyid nyams rtogs rang bzhin 'phel ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin bzhin 'thibs gyur pa'i/ /'og min gnas mchog ri dgon yang dgon du/ /snod ldan slob mas yang yang zhus pa'i ngor/ /byin rlabs nor bu rin chen mchog 'di bkod/ /dge des mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kun/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par shog /mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i byin rlabs 'bebs thabs yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ gzhan phan gyi blo kho nas yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// //athi+-itsha/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi bka' la pad ma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ lte ba sngon po 'dab ma phyogs mdog la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang gtor mas bskor la/ dbus su mgon po bskyed/ mgon po'i spyi bor yi dam yab yum/ yi dam gyi spyi bor bla ma yab yum/ mgon po'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ yi dam yab yum la phog bde ba'i rang bzhin bkrag dang gzi mdangs bskyed/ yi dam gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yab yum la phog bde ba'i rang bzhin gzi mdangs bskyed/

bla ma'i thugs kha nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams spyan drangs/ bla ma yi dam la bstim/ bla ma yi dam gyi gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang slob ma'i gnas gsum du phog pas dbang bzhi len pa 'di shin tu dam pas chig brgyud yin/ rang dgar byin na mgon pos chad pas sdigs/ lan gcig thob pas tshe gcig 'tshang rgya'o// //athi+-itsha// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 byin rlabs dbab pa dngul gyi gdung ma/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
